Provisioning sibling object stores (clones of the real repos) makes all 19 pass — matching the implementer's environment (C:/Users/郑曾波/Projects/ holds the three repos as siblings). Not a code defect; the gate fails closed. Recovery condition: run in the canonical sibling layout (as CI would need all three repos), or make REPO_DIRS configurable.
